scope: Trace-replay diagnostic autoregressive decode timings from the fixed108 P1 head-only BFP8/HiFi2 arm and selected BFP8 baseline controls. P2 is a head-only BF16/HiFi4 arm; attention, MLP and down-projection remain BFP4/LoFi. P2 is descriptive only and excluded from speed ranking due documented host contention and different outputs/lengths.

method.metric: weighted_rate=sum(decode_tokens)/sum(decode_wall_s); per-trial range is descriptive, not an unweighted aggregate.
method.timing_basis: free_running[0].decode_timing: traced autoregressive replay after first token, to synchronous token-out readback; excludes prefill/first token/text decoding. Not serving or vLLM throughput.
method.pair_identity: Exact fixture prompt_token_ids SHA-256 + seed + explicit requested cap inferred from case/result artifact names. Cap-unknown and cap-mismatched selected rows excluded from exact pair rate.
method.context_mix: Per fixed-panel row retains prompt token count, seed and requested cap; exact matched subset shares those inputs. Continuations and lengths can differ across configurations, so rates remain descriptive diagnostics rather than causal or apples-to-apples benchmark claims.

configurations.role: P1 fixed108 head-only BFP8/HiFi2 diagnostic candidate; body remains BFP4/LoFi; not accepted policy
Selected-policy BFP8/LoFi baseline controls; exact pairs only
P2 fixed108 head-only BF16/HiFi4 diagnostic arm; attention/MLP/down remain BFP4/LoFi; excluded from speed ranking
configurations.exclusion_reason: Host contention invalidates idle-host ranking (root forecast review); the changed head-only precision produced different output paths and decode lengths. This is descriptive only. No idle-host rate is imputed.

limitations: Diagnostic traced replay rate is not a vLLM or serving benchmark.
Only exact same-prompt-ID/seed/explicit-cap selected controls are included in the paired baseline comparison; many panel rows have no such selected baseline.
Even exact prompt/seed/cap pairs can generate different continuations and lengths; rate comparison is descriptive, not causal.
P2 is host-contended by the recorded incident and excluded from speed ranking; no idle-host timing is imputed.
No performance policy or score change is proposed.
